about: Welcome DMs inviting new members of the G00N SQUAD Discord to join PERMAFLEET and earn their Prospect tags (services/welcome.js, `/goon welcome`; off until someone with Manage Server turns it on). Members get it about `delayHours` after joining the server, so stewards have time to tag alliance members first; when first turned on, everyone who joined in the last `windowDays` gets it too. Each member is welcomed once, ever. Members holding any `exclude` role are skipped: alliance org members (meant to be at least E1 already), Org Stewards, and anyone already in the PERMAFLEET program. `requirement.name` is the DM script's `requires` entry; its role is the server's @everyone role (id = the server id), so the script runs only for members of the G00N SQUAD server and `/goon campaign` never offers it. Role ids are G00N SQUAD Discord role snowflakes.
title: Welcome: join PERMAFLEET
message:
**Welcome to G00N SQUAD!**
Glad you found us. G00N SQUAD flies with PERMAFLEET, an alliance of orgs that runs ops together every week, and joining PERMAFLEET is how you earn your Prospect tags here: you start at **Prospect I** and move up the ranks by showing up and flying with the fleet.

It takes two minutes: apply to PERMAFLEET on RSI (https://robertsspaceindustries.com/orgs/PERMAFLEET, then **Join us now!**), and press **Start** so leadership can match your application and tag you. This week's ops: https://goon.vc/operations/PERMAFLEET/schedule
